name: Block Brain Puzzle
situation: A logic puzzle in the spirit of Genius Square, with 62,208 valid board configurations from a seven-dice roll.
obstacle: A randomly generated board is worthless if it turns out to have no solution.
decision: Wrote the generator alongside a solver used to validate that every board produced is actually solvable, plus timed scoring and URLs that encode board state and completion time.
result: Submitted as my CS50 at Harvard final project; scored 100.
